purpose: Teach: エディション/マウント/薄型/最速/ユーザビリティ/ポテンシャル/ゼネコン/ウエイト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、限定エディションで話題作りされた
lines.en: Father — he created buzz with limited editions right from the start.
lines.style: Gentle, admiring recollection. Unhurried pace. A man remembering his son with quiet pride, each phrase settling like sediment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはマウントを取らない経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. He never pulled rank in how he ran things.
lines.style: Steady, measured affirmation. Respectful pause before speaking. The tone of a son honoring his father's lesson through the act of repeating it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、薄型テレビ事業に早期参入された
lines.en: He moved into flat-screen television early. Before anyone else saw it coming.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. The pitch lifts slightly on the last phrase—surprise still there, even in memory. Slow delivery, room for silence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは最速での意思決定を心がけた
lines.en: Yes. He believed in making decisions fast, and living with them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded. No performance—just clarity. The voice of someone who learned this by watching, not by being told.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ユーザビリティを最重視された
lines.en: He put user experience first. Everything else came after that.
lines.style: Quiet emphasis on the conviction. Slight exhale before speaking. The pace deliberate, almost teaching. A man explaining what mattered most.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員のポテンシャルを信じた
lines.en: Yes. He trusted his people. Believed in what they could become.
lines.style: Warm and certain. Gentle firmness on 「信じた」. The cadence of someone who watched this trust pay off, time and again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ゼネコンとの折衝も自ら担われた
lines.en: He handled the construction company negotiations himself. Never delegated the hard conversations.
lines.style: Admiring, with a thread of knowing what that cost. Deliberate pacing. The voice of someone who understands the weight of that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営のウエイトを未来に置かれた
lines.en: Yes. He kept his eye on the future. Even when the present was demanding everything.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom settling in. Gentle finality—not closure, but a moment of understanding. Warm and composed, the voice of accumulated years.
